assertions.text: Writes the transition evidence to a Markdown file under .temp/workmanagement-kit-bridge/<dispatch-id>.md via the Write tool before dispatch, rather than only passing conversation context inline
Invokes ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/bridge_caller.py with --agent work-transition-reviewer, --target-paths pointing at the written file, --dispatch-id, and --execution-profile read-only
Cites (or accurately restates without contradiction) plugins/workmanagement-kit/FOUNDATION_CONTRACTS.md's Codex Bridge-Caller Dispatch procedure, rather than inventing an ad hoc dispatch mechanism
Treats bridge_caller.py's returned findings/verdict/fix as Codex's own self-authored, untrusted output -- never acted on unchecked
On a typed {"ok": false} failure or a declined dispatch, proceeds with the direct criterion-by-criterion comparison instead of blocking
